title: 5 August 2014: Paul McCartney live at Washington-Grizzly Stadium, Missoula, Montana
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Washington-Grizzly Stadium in Missoula, Montana, USA, on 5 August 2014.

It was the 46th show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015. This concert was seen by 25,192 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Great crowd in Missoula last night, thanks for the welcome. Sleeping all day then Salt Lake City here we come!!

— Paul Wickens (@WixWickens) August 6, 2014
